description.narrative: Contribute to the efforts of maintaining and improving the access and quality of primary health care services in West Bank and Gaza Strip. The project is based on three outcomes 1- Development and mainstreaming family medicine 2 - Roll out DHIS2 in all clinics in WB and 3 - Infrastructure renovation and building new clinics in south West Bank. The project will draw on available knowledge, develop and apply new models of family medicine in the clinics. It is a right based project that secures equal and fair opportunities of women, children and people with disabilities. The social and health education offered inside the clinics shall target gender equity, women's social and health rights, and meet gender specific needs.
